assets.prompt: Edit/create the staff avatar of 김보미 using image 1 ONLY as identity reference and image 2 ONLY as a general earlier cartoon avatar reference. Identity: soft rounded face, long center-parted dark hair with softly curved ends, subtle friendly closed smile. Make a clearly animated 3D handmade clay toy character, much more cartoon-like than the second reference sheet. Large rounded head, compact shoulders and tiny torso, cheerful soft rounded silhouette. Smooth matte clay skin with no pores, no skin microtexture, no facial wrinkles, no nasolabial lines. Rounded simplified cheeks, small button nose, a simple curved mouth sculpted from clay; no realistic glossy lips. Large expressive dark simplified eyes, stylized solid irises, no photographic iris detail, no individual eyelashes. Thick simple sculpted eyebrows. Hair is made of just a few large rounded flowing clay shapes, NOT strands or finely etched grooves. A cute adult staff caricature, not a realistic 3D scan, not a realistic human portrait. Preserve recognizability through hairstyle, face silhouette and expression, rather than photo realism. High quality polished toy animation aesthetic, warm soft studio light and restrained palette. Authentic contemporary Korean hanok cafe staff uniform, from the user's September 11 sewing design: cocoa greige jeogori #786C5F, matching collar, simple charcoal goreum tie/vertical trim, hidden inside snap fastening; warm charcoal #4F4C43 long waist apron, extending slightly below mid-calf, no bib straps over the chest. Low saturation matte fabric translated into smooth sculpted clay. Korean jeogori, not Japanese kimono or Chinese qipao. Show the Korean collar and charcoal tie clearly, and the top of the waist apron. No logo or name text, no hat. One person only, front facing centered head-to-waist portrait, head fills about 55% of image height with hair completely inside canvas and enough transparent margin on every side. Keep both shoulders inside the frame. No hands needed. Square transparent background. The final face must look sculpted and cartoon-like at a 40px avatar size, not like a photograph. Do not reproduce any other people from image 2.
